summary: Iter7: verified SEC-001 fix (server-side session-bound active member) + full backend regression + frontend flow. Backend: 13/13 tests pass on test_iter6_security.py (family create auto-activates capo, verify-pin correct/wrong/empty, X-Member-Id spoofing rejected with 403, deactivate keeps session but blocks mutations, DELETE /auth/session revokes, Pydantic validation 422 for empty title / bad PIN / negative points / >1000 char comments, full activity+comment+reward CRUD, only capo regenerates code, /register-push requires auth). Preset 'Porta a spasso il cane' confirmed removed from both /api/presets response and MemberSheet UI. Frontend: login screen renders 'Miska (Developer)' via testID dev-credit; Profilo tab also shows dev-credit at bottom; create-family -> Oggi -> add-activity FAB -> chat inputs all reachable. After page reload the server-stored active_member_id keeps the profile active (FAB present, no 403, no console errors). 'Cambia utente' returns to select-member; a capo without PIN is admitted (verify-pin with empty body). No react-native deprecated packages detected (expo-audio/expo-video/expo-camera not needed). Minor: react-native-web logs 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' warning (non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web console warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'. Non-blocking but should be migrated in a future pass. Reference: theme/component StyleSheet definitions using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset (e.g. /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:88-93).

action_items: (Optional) Replace shadow* React Native style props with boxShadow to remove console warning on web.
No functional fixes required from main agent for this iteration — security audit fix verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_actor now correctly derives the acting member from session.active_member_id and ignores mismatched X-Member-Id headers — SEC-001 resolved.
CORS: allow_credentials=False with wildcard origins — correct since auth is Bearer-token (no cookies).
Pydantic constraints (Field(min_length/max_length/pattern/ge/le)) applied on all mutating request bodies — good.
Rate-limiting on PIN/invite code intentionally NOT implemented per user's explicit choice; not reported as a bug.
server.py is ~1150 lines; consider splitting routers (auth/family/activities/rewards/push) into modules in a future refactor — not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test families via API (TEST_Iter6_Family, TEST_UI_Iter7, TEST_UI_Refresh, TEST_UI_AddFlow, TEST_Revoke) — all prefixed TEST_ and only in test DB collections. No fixture updates required for /app/memory/test_credentials.md as the pre-existing capo fixture (Mamma PIN 1234) remains valid.

If future iterations touch auth/session logic re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_security.py. Correct add-activity testIDs: 'add-activity-fab', 'input-activity-title', 'save-activity-btn'. For select-member, PIN field is optional in create-family; when no PIN set, tapping the capo cell in select-member calls verify-pin with empty body and enters directly.
